notes: Fresh synthetic room and proxy per run. No production routes or data.
Streaming completion includes the final unthrottled stats verification request.
Byte counts are forwarded HTTP/WebSocket bytes, excluding TLS/TCP/IP overhead.
The proxy forces HTTP connection close; connection counts do not measure production HTTP pooling.
p95 is not used for comparisons: duplicate-arrival filtering was added during testing.
Upload reports elapsed time from setup, through upload, peer delivery and sender ACK.
No physical packet loss, airplane Wi-Fi, mobile lifecycle or arbitrary relay RPC benchmark.
